Survey.Title: Smoking Issues Awareness and Attitude Survey

Questions.Statement: Whether people smoke or not is their decision alone
Smokers should have equal opportunities with non-smokers for advancement at work
There should be more pressure on smokers to quit smoking
I'm more willing to ask people not to smoke than I used to be
Smokers should not be allowed to work for the government
I'm tired of all the anti-smoking publicity
A company should not be allowed to fire somebody because they smoke
Smoking should be banned in offices and workplaces
I think less of people because they smoke
I think there is a good balance today between the rights of smokers and non-smokers
People should not be denied jobs just because they smoke
I find that I'm becoming less and less tolerant of smokers
When smoking gets attention in the news media, I feel more comfortable about taking an anti-smoking position
